_comment: Chapter 2 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F08, a rescue: the blacksmith goes home (the village forge).

text.zh_TW: 鐵匠被鎖在鐵籠裡，正用頭撞籠子。「里歐！快，這籠子的鎖是爛貨——用力踢！」
text.en: The blacksmith is locked in an iron cage, butting it with his head. "Leo! Quick, the lock's junk. Kick it hard!"

text.zh_TW: 鐵匠：「哈！我就說是爛貨。回村後來我的鋪子，我幫你把武器磨亮。」
text.en: Blacksmith: "Ha! Told you it was junk. Come to my forge back home and I'll put an edge on your weapon."
